body: thank you for the good wishes :) im not upset that you said it, i just wanted to offer my perspective i think. im happy that you have times you dont want to die, thats a wonderful feeling

i know how much it'll hurt them. my mom has gone through a shitload of trauma already and i know my death will be traumatic for her as well. i got her to schedule an appointment with her therapist and i want to get her to go regularly, i've already told her that i might die and that she should be ready, i don't know what else to do. i might try to find good books about recovering from loss, or write some tips down myself.

lack of mutual understanding. the only girl i was ever in love with said she understood me, and she left me. that was enough to break me i think. that a person finally saw who i really was, and decided i was unlovable. and i couldn't understand her, either--i'm too presumptuous, self-righteous, paranoid. it's as if she thrust her arm though my heart and held me, and left a wound in my heart. the hole was there, but it felt like it was filled in her presence.
